about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Driven by Autonomy & Precision.
about.intro_kicker: I am Md Sahadat Hossain — an Autonomous Systems Engineer & AI Architect who transforms cutting-edge AI models into resilient, scalable, production-grade software.
about.bio_p1: My journey into technology was born not from a classroom syllabus, but from a lifelong obsession with code, web architecture, and digital engineering since childhood. While I completed my Master's Degree, my real engineering edge was forged through relentless independent research, continuous experimentation, and building tangible software from the ground up.
about.bio_p2:
I believe true engineering is proven by execution, not certificates — demonstrated through resilient backend architectures, intuitive frontend experiences, and software that delivers real-world impact. Combining deep fluency in modern web standards (HTML5, CSS, modern JavaScript, Python) with frontier AI models (Claude Opus & Sonnet, OpenAI GPT-4o, Google Gemini), I orchestrate intelligent, self-operating multi-agent ecosystems designed to scale.

Core Targets & Impact:
• 10x Execution Velocity: Compressing weeks of traditional development into hours using autonomous agent swarms that scaffold, test, and self-heal.
• 70% Cost Compression: Eliminating bloated agency retainers and manual overhead through deterministic, automated AI pipelines.
• Zero-Hallucination Resilience: Engineering strict guardrails, structured JSON schemas, and automated lint verification for flawless production output.
